tool_args.rationale: A saturating input term with rational gradient suppression and an additive square-root term fits all nine observations at H = 0.6 to rounding precision. Submit it for fresh confirmation; the paid rows do not establish what happens beyond the sampled gradient range.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All nine rows agree with the smooth law to rounding precision. No activation is observed, so a threshold and its strength cannot be estimated.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition or Cobb–Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Haldane omits the observed gradient dependence; a single Cobb–Douglas power law does not reproduce the observed curvature.
The open-branch and trajectory probes have already been acquired, and the remaining nuisance probe cannot distinguish the candidate laws.
